decisions.reason: Core distributed lighting control with strong launch claims aligns with strategic integrated solutions, so results likely meet aspirations and slack allows keeping it.
Air situation display supports surveillance core offering, and with firm hiring and industry growth, slack permits carrying it despite limited promotional evidence.
Training program complements the integrated offer, and even if results are uncertain, organizational slack from growth makes dropping unnecessary.
Niche lighting training course has lower strategic emphasis, but slack and its link to core lighting products reduce the likelihood of dropping within the year.
Collaboration software tool fits the firm's move toward data-driven integrated operations, so it likely meets aspirations and is retained.
Advanced multilateration surveillance system is central to the firm's surveillance portfolio and was launched prominently, indicating satisfactory performance and low drop risk.
